Steps to fix the compilation error:

1. Make sure your tsconfig.json has these settings:
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "target": "ESNext",
    "allowJs": true
  }
}
```

2. Update your vite.config.ts to include:
```typescript
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react-swc';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  esbuild: {
    jsx: 'automatic'
  }
});
```

3. Add this line at the top of your Booking.tsx file:
```typescript
/// <reference types="react" />
```

4. Make sure your file has the .tsx extension (which it already does)

5. Try clearing the Vite cache:
```bash
rm -rf node_modules/.vite
```

6. Restart your dev server:
```bash
npm run dev
```
